{{Quote|TIE Raptors. New design, nice to fly.|[[Tetran Cowall]]|<ref name="Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>}}
The '''TIE/rpt starfighter''', or '''TIE Raptor''', was an unofficial, smaller variant of the standard [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]].

==Characteristics==
Like all [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] craft, the Raptor had a spherical cockpit with an octagonal forward window, but rather than the usual large wings on either side, it had four short fins protruding directly from the cockpit assembly at right angles to one another. Although not as fast as a [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]], it was as maneuverable as an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]], and heavily armed, with four [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and two [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] tubes. A few prototypes were also equipped with [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]].<ref name="CTD" />

==History==
The TIE Raptor appeared in the years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and was designed by [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s engineers in his shipyards at [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] for the exclusive use of his faction's forces.<ref name="CTD" />

[[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] played no role in the project aside from creating the original TIE series design lineage, and the Raptor saw little or no use among units of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] loyal to central authorities.
